title: Commander's Arsenal Oversized: card flavor text

entities.name: Azusa, Lost but Seeking
entities.description: A wanderer who has left Jukai Forest and considers all of Kamigawa her home and its people her family.

entities.name: Jukai Forest
entities.description: A forest on Kamigawa that Azusa says is not her home.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane Azusa calls her home.

entities.name: Sliver Queen
entities.description: The mother of slivers, whose children are ever part of her.

entities.name: Zur the Enchanter
entities.description: An enchanter who stayed aloof from Terisiare's suffering, intent only on his own perfection.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: A land that suffered while Zur remained aloof.

relations.quote: My home is Kamigawa, its people my family.

relations.note: Azusa contrasts the forest with Kamigawa as a whole
relations.quote: I do not miss Jukai Forest. It is not my home. My home is Kamigawa, its people my family.
Zur remained aloof from Terisiare's suffering, intent only on his own perfection.
